The '''panagra''' were a predatory [[Species/Legends|species]] which stalked their [[Foodstuff/Legends|prey]]. They were native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dressel/Legends|Dressel]], where they lived in [[Steepara tree|steepara]] forests and posed a constant threat to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Dressellian/Legends|Dressellian]] species who also called the planet home.<ref name="SOT" />

==Behind the scenes==
Panagra were first mentioned in [[Stay on Target (sourcebook)|''Stay on Target'']], a supplement released in [[2015]] by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] roleplaying game.
